lam_gn_found_effect = {
	save_scope_as = lam_gn_lead
	clear_saved_scope = lam_gn_book
	liege ?= {
		lam_gn_book_ensure_effect = yes
		var:lam_gn_book ?= {
			save_scope_as = lam_gn_book
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:lam_gn_book
		}
		scope:lam_gn_book = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_gn_n
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_gn_n
					value = 0
				}
			}
			scope:lam_gn_lead = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = lam_gn_from
						NOT = {
							var:lam_gn_from_book ?= scope:lam_gn_book
						}
					}
					remove_variable = lam_gn_from
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = lam_gn_n
						}
						var:lam_gn_n >= 20
					}
					trigger_else = {
						always = no
					}
				}
				lam_gn_shift_effect = yes
				scope:lam_gn_lead = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = lam_gn_from
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								var:lam_gn_from = scope:lam_gn_cut
							}
							remove_variable = lam_gn_from
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = {
								var:lam_gn_from > scope:lam_gn_cut
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = lam_gn_from
								add = -1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = lam_gn_n
				add = 1
			}
			scope:lam_gn_lead = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = lam_gn_from
						var:lam_gn_from >= scope:lam_gn_book.var:lam_gn_n
					}
					remove_variable = lam_gn_from
				}
			}
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = lam_gn_dep
				value = 0
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_gn_lead = {
						has_variable = lam_gn_from
					}
				}
				lam_gn_parent_depth_effect = yes
			}
			lam_gn_write_effect = yes
		}
		scope:lam_gn_lead = {
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_rec
				value = scope:lam_gn_book.var:lam_gn_n
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_rec_title
				value = scope:lam_gn_book
			}
		}
		scope:lam_gn_book = {
			lam_gn_hold_effect = {
				WHO = scope:lam_gn_lead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_from
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_from
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_from_book
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_from_book
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_why
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_why
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_sr
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_sr
	}
	lam_st_record_effect = {
		KEY = founded
	}
	lam_bp_archive_effect = yes
}
lam_gn_view_main_effect = {
	var:lam_fac_view ?= {
		lam_gn_book_ensure_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:lam_fac_view ?= {
				has_variable = lam_gn_book
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_gn_view
			value = var:lam_fac_view.var:lam_gn_book
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		var:lam_gn_view ?= {
			lam_gn_tree_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
lam_gn_book_ensure_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = lam_gn_book
			}
			exists = primary_title
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_gn_book
			value = primary_title
		}
	}
}
lam_gn_hold_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = {
					name = lam_gn_holders
					target = $WHO$
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = lam_gn_holders
			target = $WHO$
		}
	}
}

lam_gn_note_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_rec_title
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_gn_k
			value = flag:$KEY$
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_gn_k
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:rise
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:won
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:lost
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:crown
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:purge
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:underground
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:seized
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:oath_broken
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:betray
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:challenge
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:disgraced
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:pardoned
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:allied
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:split
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:cp_broken
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:surfaced
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:ult_yield
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:ult_oath
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:ult_arrest
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:ult_defied
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:migrated
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:loyal_honor
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:treason
						var:lam_gn_k ?= flag:loyal_house
					}
				}
				lam_gn_event_effect = {
					KEY = $KEY$
				}
			}
			remove_variable = lam_gn_k
		}
	}
}

lam_gn_news_put_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = lam_news1_k
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news1_book
			value = scope:lam_news_book
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news1_n
			value = $N$
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news1_k
			value = flag:$K$
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = lam_news2_k
			}
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					var:lam_news1_book ?= scope:lam_news_book
					var:lam_news1_n ?= $N$
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news2_book
			value = scope:lam_news_book
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news2_n
			value = $N$
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_news2_k
			value = flag:$K$
		}
	}
}

lam_gc_select_effect = {
	lam_gc_unselect_effect = yes
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_gc_sel
		value = var:lam_gc$X$_$Y$_r
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gc$X$_$Y$_h
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_gc_selh
			value = var:lam_gc$X$_$Y$_h
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gc$X$_$Y$_l
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_gc_sell
			value = yes
		}
	}
	lam_st_record_select_effect = yes
	lam_bp_archive_select_effect = yes
}
lam_gc_unselect_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gc_sel
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gc_sel
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gc_selh
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gc_selh
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gc_sell
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gc_sell
	}
	lam_st_record_unselect_effect = yes
	lam_bp_archive_unselect_effect = yes
}
